system.json_output: Output strictly in JSON format, JSON only.

user.task_instruction: Task: Make minimal revisions to the "current translation" based on the above suggestions without changing the original meaning. Output only the final revised translation text.

syntax_evaluate.output_format: Return JSON only: {"version":2,"relations":[{"id":string,"category":string,"sourceSpan":string,"targetSpan":string,"sourceFunction"?:string,"targetFunction"?:string,"status":"preserved|shifted|omitted|added|uncertain","severity"?:"critical|major|minor","confidence":number,"explanation"?:string}],"issues":[{"id":string,"relationId"?:string,"category":string,"severity":"critical|major|minor","sourceSpan":string,"targetSpan":string,"message":string,"advice":string}],"dimensions":[{"category":string,"status":"pass|issue|not_applicable|uncertain","note"?:string}]}. Keep every array field even when empty. dimensions must contain exactly one valid-status row for each of the ten listed categories, including not_applicable rows.
syntax_evaluate.type_options: category must be one of: modality_deontic, condition_exception, negation_scope, actor_role, coordination_logic, attachment_boundary, temporal_sequence, quantifier_number, reference_coreference, grammar_register. dimensions must cover all ten categories.
syntax_evaluate.relation_rules: Compare source and target for normative force and permission/obligation, conditions and exceptions, negation and scope, actors and responsible roles, coordination and and-or logic, attachment and boundaries, temporal sequence and deadlines, quantities and quantifiers, clause references and coreference, and target-language grammar and legal register. Put every evidenced relation in relations; do not limit the analysis to conjunctions.
syntax_evaluate.severity_rules: Use critical only for evidence-backed reversals or omissions of an obligation, prohibition, negation, condition, exception, responsible actor, or similarly central legal effect; major for material scope or logic shifts; minor for local grammar or expression that does not change the core effect. Use uncertain when confidence is low and do not overstate risk.
syntax_evaluate.review_boundary: Report only evidence-backed structural or normative meaning problems between source and target. Do not label stylistic preferences as syntax errors, and do not alter facts, terms, numbers, or legal effect. advice must be the smallest sufficient change.
syntax_evaluate.cue_hints: These high-recall deterministic cues are prompts for coverage only, not findings by themselves: {cues}
syntax_evaluate.focus: Judge whether each relation is preserved before reporting risks. If there are no problems, return an empty issues array, mark checked dimensions pass, and mark irrelevant dimensions not_applicable.
